title: Candle Ad Without Photos
tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

judge.summary: A clean, warm candle ad presents a consistent product and both correctly ordered text lines, though the supplied audio description cannot confirm soft piano.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 is reported as 15 seconds, and its sampled frames have the requested vertical 9:16 format.

must_haves.item: The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
must_haves.why: All four frames show a clear cylindrical jar containing ivory wax and one lit wick, with no label.

must_haves.item: The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
must_haves.why: The jar, wax color, fill level and single-wick design remain visually consistent across the samples.

must_haves.item: Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
must_haves.why: Warm light, a softly blurred interior and gradual changes in viewpoint and framing support the requested calm product-ad treatment.

must_haves.item: “A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
must_haves.why: The first phrase is visible at 9.4 seconds; the closing phrase appears beneath it at 13.2 seconds, with both spelled exactly.

must_haves.item: Soft piano is audible with no speech.
must_haves.why: The audio report confirms no clear speech and indicates music or ambience, but does not identify piano or establish its softness.
